title: Fractional Parts of Different Wholes
objective: Represent and identify fractional parts of different wholes.

problems.text: Draw a picture of the yellow strip at 3 (or 4) different stations. Shade and label 1 fractional unit of each.
Draw a picture of the brown bar at 3 (or 4) different stations. Shade and label 1 fractional unit of each.
Draw a picture of the square at 3 (or 4) different stations. Shade and label 1 fractional unit of each.
Draw a picture of the clay at 3 (or 4) different stations. Shade and label 1 fractional unit of each.
Draw a picture of the water at 3 (or 4) different stations. Shade and label 1 fractional unit of each.
Extension: Draw a picture of the yarn at 3 (or 4) different stations.
